source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Complete the performance report from the test records.
3. Reenter the test records into a performance report on the Excel form attached.
4. Reenter the test record results into the performance summary sheet.
5. Calculate the deviation from the advertised specifications using the function `=B{row number}-D{row number}` in the “Deviation” column. The “B” cell references the actual test result, and the “D” cell references the advertised specification.
6. Open a new sheet and name it “Failed Deviations”.
7. Filter the “Deviation” column to only show those values that have negative values (that is, those that are below the advertised minimum value or above the advertised maximum value, depending on the test).
8. Copy the values in each of the test columns corresponding to those tests that failed the advertised specification. It does not matter if the deviation (above or below the advertised specification) is due to
